decisions.reason: The cleaning soap was promoted to its own page in 2024, a visible commitment that management would not reverse, and it supports the floor range as a low-cost care add-on.

The maintenance oil line extends the established oiled-floor offer and carries several models, so dropping it would write off the investment, and nothing suggests its results cannot be explained by temporary causes.
The care line for oiled floors gained a dedicated page in 2024, showing growing public commitment that management would want to justify rather than abandon.
The moisture-protection underlay is a complementary accessory with only modest visible commitment, which makes it somewhat more exposed, but it still fits the system offer and is kept.

The high-density underlay is a low-investment accessory that was only mentioned on the website and overlaps with other underlays, so it is the most likely to be dropped, yet keeping it remains the default.
The oak parquet line is core to the firm's flooring identity and involves substantial production investment, so management would persist with it.
